Dear Michael,

I authorize disclosure of the enclosed patent materials to you for a confidential scope and fee assessment before a separately signed NDA. Please treat the materials as confidential and limit access to personnel needed for that assessment. Please obtain my prior approval before sharing them with any outside associate.

The same review package comprises five independently usable ZIP attachments, sent in five numbered emails because of their size. Parts 1–4 contain the available PPA #1–10 file sets. Part 5 contains the English client memo, supplemental figures, client-prepared specification skeleton, filing indexes and ownership review documents. Please read READ_FIRST_EN.txt in Part 5. The archive copies and editable files require verification against the official filed records.

The US work to quote is NPPA #1 (PPAs #3–7), NPPA #2 (PPAs #1,2,8,9), and review/finalization and USPTO recordation of the PBK-to-Mikhail Kozin assignment. PPA #10 is background only at this stage. Russian patent work will be handled separately by Russian professionals.

PCT IS A PARTICULAR PRIORITY FOR YOUR RESPONSE:
1. Can you lawfully act as the formal PCT representative in my circumstances, or only prepare and coordinate materials? I am a Russian citizen residing in Sharjah, UAE. The proposed transfer from PBK to me has not been established as completed.
2. Please identify the proposed applicant, receiving Office (including whether RO/IB is appropriate), named authorized representative and the basis of that person's authority. If an outside representative is needed, please identify the person, responsibilities and fee for approval.
3. Please assess whether separate PCT applications are appropriate for groups #1 and #2 and quote each separately. Please distinguish drafting/coordination from actual filing and include official fees, associates, translations, drawings and exclusions.
4. Please verify priority support, ownership and the applicable deadlines from the records; our working control dates are December 11, 2026 for group #2 and December 23, 2026 for group #1. Please propose actual draft, review and filing dates with a contingency buffer.

Please provide a firm itemized quote or fee cap after review, payment milestones, included revision rounds, additional charges and missing-document list. Please confirm whether review of priority support and ownership is included in the main quoted work.

Known limitations are stated in READ_FIRST_EN.txt: no separately identified completed nonprovisional draft by Ali was located; the included skeleton is client-prepared and must not be attributed to him. No separate figures PDF is present in the PPA #9 archived folder; please inspect the specification. Ownership documents are review drafts, not proof of executed transfer or recordation.

This disclosure does not accept an engagement or authorize paid review, other billable work, filing or recordation. If any assessment is chargeable, please propose and obtain approval of its scope and cost before starting. Please confirm receipt of all five parts and the earliest date you can provide your final proposal. Written correspondence is preferred as I do not speak English.

Thank you for offering an initial no-charge scope assessment. Please also review the attached NDA template, identify Mikhail Kozin individually and PBK ENGINEERING INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS MANAGEMENT - FZCO as the two disclosing parties, include appropriate signature blocks, and return a signed version or proposed revisions. I authorize this initial disclosure without waiting for your signature, but still request that we complete the NDA.

Kind regards,
Mikhail Kozin
